question: Should ClickClack adopt optional persistent channel purpose text as a long-term public channel contract across storage engines, APIs, SDKs, and both channel headers?
rationale: The patch is a new durable metadata capability, not a repair to established behavior, so maintainers must choose whether to own its migration and public compatibility surface.

options.title: Accept the channel-purpose contract
options.body: Merge after confirming that the additive database migration and public API/SDK field are desired supported product behavior.

options.title: Defer or narrow the metadata surface
options.body: Keep the PR open while maintainers decide whether a smaller or non-persistent channel-context approach better fits the product.

recommendation.title: Accept the channel-purpose contract
recommendation.body: Merge after confirming that the additive database migration and public API/SDK field are desired supported product behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor can clarify or adjust the proposed contract; current-main feature-history owners could not be established in the blocked environment.
